lines: The real power of Apex is building a team — and earning on everything they produce.
That team income is called override — a share that flows up to you as your team sells.
You get paid two ways at once: what you personally sell, and what your whole team sells.
On the Insurance side, overrides pay six generations deep — from your recruits all the way down.
Here's how it can add up. You recruit five agents, and your team grows to twenty.
If each writes around five thousand a month, your override income can reach about seventy-five hundred a month.
That's roughly ninety thousand a year — on top of your own personal commissions.
Stay productive, and a weekly bonus rewards consistency — one to four percent, tier by tier.
Reach M.G.A. and build your own shop, and a quarterly recruiting bonus pays up to six thousand.
On the Technology side, every rank you reach also pays a one-time bonus.
Across all nine ranks, that's more than ninety-three thousand dollars in rank bonuses.
Run both ladders, and you build two income streams — with one team behind you.
Build the team, earn on their production, and stack the bonuses. That's how Apex income compounds.
